# Projelli

> Local-first AI workspace for indie founders. Every chat with Claude, GPT, or Gemini becomes a real Markdown file on the user's machine. Bring your own API key, no subscription, sold once.

## What Projelli is

Projelli is a desktop application (Windows, macOS, Linux) that combines a Markdown editor, a workspace-aware AI chat, and 15 founder-focused workflow templates. Built with Tauri 2 + React + TypeScript. Approximately 25,000 lines of source.

Unlike chat-first AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude.ai, Gemini), Projelli treats files as first-class citizens. Every AI conversation produces a persistent `.aichat` file. Workflow runs save as `.workflow` files. Whiteboards, audio recordings, and research source cards all live as real files in a folder the user picks.

Unlike workspace-first tools (Notion AI, Reflect, Tana, Mem.ai), Projelli is local-first. Data lives on the user's hard drive in standard formats. No cloud, no accounts, no telemetry, no server-side AI.

## Who Projelli is for

Indie founders, building-in-public solopreneurs, solo developers shipping software products. Privacy-leaning, cost-leaning, and comfortable bringing their own API key.

Projelli is not designed for enterprise teams, non-technical solopreneurs who want one-click everything, or hobbyists with no monetization goal.

## Differentiation (the five message pillars)

1. **Local-first**: data stays on the user's machine. No cloud sync, no telemetry, no server-side database.
2. **BYOK (Bring Your Own Key)**: users supply their own Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google AI Studio API key. Projelli never holds AI credentials and AI requests go directly from the user's machine to the AI provider.
3. **Chat-as-files**: every AI conversation produces a real Markdown file the user can open, edit, version, back up, or delete with regular file system tools.
4. **Founder-specific templates**: 15 workflow templates for the work indie founders actually do (pitch deck, customer interview guide, financial projections, weekly review, MVP scope, go-to-market plan, investor update, board meeting prep, first hire playbook, and more).
5. **Sold once**: no subscription. $49 one-time for Pro, $99 one-time for Lifetime, with a $29 Founder's Lifetime tier capped at the first 100 buyers.

## Pricing

| Tier | Price | What it includes |
|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | Core editor, file tree, Markdown, wiki-links, version history, audit log, 1 AI provider (Claude only), 3 templates, 1 workspace |
| Pro | $49 one-time | Everything Free has + all 3 AI providers + all 15 templates + unlimited workspaces + whiteboard + audio + research/citations + 1 year of updates |
| Lifetime | $99 one-time | Everything Pro has + updates forever + early access + commercial use license |
| Founder's Launch | $29 one-time | Lifetime tier at the founder's price, capped at the first 100 buyers |

Sold via LemonSqueezy (merchant of record handles VAT, tax, refunds). 14-day refund window, no questions asked.

## Platform support

- Windows: NSIS installer signed by Microsoft Azure Trusted Signing (no SmartScreen warning)
- macOS: Universal binary (Apple Silicon + Intel) signed by Apple Developer ID
- Linux: AppImage and `.deb` packages

Auto-updates land via GitHub Releases for v1.0.8 and later, with minisign-signed update bundles.

## Architecture

- Tauri 2 (Rust) shell, React 18 + TypeScript 5 + Vite 5 frontend
- Zustand for state, shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS for UI, CodeMirror 6 for text editing, TipTap for rich text
- Three AI providers: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini (BYOK, streaming, tool use)
- File formats: `.md`, `.txt`, `.aichat`, `.workflow`, `.whiteboard`, `.source`, plus full read/write for `.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.csv`, `.rtf`, `.pdf`, `.pptx`
- MCP server support: Projelli speaks the Model Context Protocol and can act as a client
- No server-side state. No telemetry. No tracking pixels. Plausible analytics on the marketing site only.

## Privacy and security

- No data collection from the desktop app
- No telemetry
- API keys stored in OS keychain on macOS, encrypted file fallback elsewhere
- All AI requests go directly from the user's machine to the AI provider
- See https://projelli.com/legal/privacy for the full Privacy Policy

## Comparison to alternatives

- **Notion AI**: Notion is a cloud team workspace; Projelli is a local-first single-user tool. Notion AI is bundled at $20/month; Projelli is $49 one-time and uses the user's own API key.
- **Obsidian (with AI plugins)**: Obsidian is the closest spiritual cousin, also local-first and Markdown-based. Projelli adds first-class AI chat, founder-specific templates, and built-in BYOK; Obsidian users build this from plugins.
- **ChatGPT Projects / Claude.ai Projects**: web-based, cloud-stored, locked to a single AI provider. Projelli is desktop, local, multi-provider, and the chat history is yours in Markdown.
- **Reflect, Tana, Mem.ai**: AI-first cloud notes tools. Projelli is local-first.
- **Cursor**: code editor with AI. Projelli is for non-code workflows (writing, planning, founder docs).

For per-competitor comparison pages, see https://projelli.com/vs/
